name: mufu_class
kind: installation, book-keeping only: the replay's wait of a MUFU on its execution unit (ledger reason unit:xu_smsp on a MUFU instruction) is mapped to the hardware class mio_throttle instead of math_pipe_throttle; no engine, tree or leaf change, no replay
mechanisms: configs/stall/class_mapping.json (reason -> ncu class), python/cyclescope/stall (the mapping may look at the instruction's operation class)
why: Stage 2 of dev/design/stall-attribution.md, first of three installation steps. Full GPU (full-place5, points of residency on MUFU pcs, hardware / replay): mio_throttle 0.87 / 0.00 and math_pipe_throttle 0.00 / 1.44 on H100, 0.19 / 0.00 and 0.00 / 0.65 on B300 (compare/place5/<set>/kind_gaps.tsv).
evidence: plan_pilot v1 (both devices): the wait of a MUFU run is on the MUFU itself as mio_throttle, never math_pipe_throttle; one warp and saturated.

queue_basic v1 readings (both devices; $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/queue_basic-readings/<device>.role.tsv): in q.mufu.e2 / .e2.w8 / .e2.w16 / .e4 / .e4.w16, q.seq.sts10_mufu6, q.seq.mufu10_sts6, q.seq.mufu4_f2fp4 every wait on a MUFU pc beyond not_selected is mio_throttle (H100 81.0, 175.3, 383.2, 23.9, 171.6, 32.0, 60.0, 18.0 per iteration; B300 26.9, 60.1, 139.1, 0, 0, 14.0, 25.9, 7.9) where the replay has unit:xu_smsp (H100 87.6, ..., B300 27.5, ...); hardware math_pipe_throttle on those pcs is 0. F2FP (unit alu_smsp) waits as math_pipe_throttle on both sides and is not touched.
No probe covers the other instructions of unit xu_smsp (F2F, F2I, I2F, POPC, FLO, BREV, FCHK, REDUX, CREDUX); their mapping stays as it is (hypothesis) until one does.

rule.M1: A rule of configs/stall/class_mapping.json may carry an `operation` regular expression; such a rule applies to a ledger row only when the row's operation class (third column of a residency row of the stall ledger) matches it. Rules without `operation` behave as before. First match wins, as before.
rule.M2: New rule in front of the generic `^unit:` rule: reason `^unit:xu_smsp`, operation `^MUFU(\.|$)`, class mio_throttle, evidence calibrated, source this protocol.
rule.scope: Both devices (evidence on both). Nothing else changes: the ledgers of every existing replay are reused as they are, so cycles are identical by construction (no replay is run).

criteria.K1 (pure relabel, per pc): For every cell of the probe sources of manifest-place5.<device>.tsv plus queue_basic, on both devices, the replay's per-pc class table computed with the new mapping equals the one computed with the old mapping at every (pc, class), except that on pcs whose instruction is MUFU the cycles of reason unit:xu_smsp have moved from math_pipe_throttle to mio_throttle, cycle for cycle. Checked from the same ledgers by a judge script; any other difference fails.
criteria.K2 (direction, per pc and class): For each MUFU cell of queue_basic and plan_pilot-r2 on each device, the cell's (pc, class) error against hardware pass a (probe scoreboard, loop scope) does not increase, and decreases in every cell where the replay has at least 0.5 cycles per execution of unit:xu_smsp on a MUFU pc. Hand-derived before freezing from the role tables: e.g. H100 q.mufu.e2 the MUFU pcs contribute |81.0 - 0| + |0 - 87.6| before and |81.0 - 87.6| after; B300 q.mufu.e4 / .e4.w16 have no such wait and stay equal.
criteria.K3 (full GPU, by kind): compare_sets.sh on the ledgers of full-place5 with the new mapping: in <set>/kind_gaps.tsv every row whose kind is not MUFU has the same replay value as in compare/place5, and on MUFU the replay's math_pipe_throttle is 0 with its former value on mio_throttle. Cycles: the same ledger files, no replay. The ten error levels and the class gaps are reported before / after against the noise floor; they are not pass / fail.
criteria.gates: pytest (the mapping and compare tests, with new cases for the operation match), and the other six gates on a clean clone although no engine source changes.

expectation_not_criterion: Full GPU: the mio_throttle gap closes by the replay's former math_pipe_throttle on MUFU (about 1.4 / 0.65 points) but overshoots the hardware's 0.87 / 0.19 on MUFU pcs, because part of what the hardware books on MUFU pcs is `wait` (1.07 / 0.84 against the replay's 0.20 / 0.16); math_pipe_throttle's excess falls by the same amount; the attribution error falls.
not_allowed: No leaf, engine or tree change; no mapping change for an instruction without probe evidence; no full-GPU error used to choose the rule.

addenda.when: 2026-11-22, installation and judgement (M1 + M2 = commit 63a77fcd; gates on clean clone stall-attribution-51, build $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/build-63a77fcd; judge tools/microbench/mufu_class/judge.py; old mapping tools/microbench/mufu_class/class_mapping.before.json = the file at dddccc50; outputs $CYCLESCOPE_ARTIFACT_ROOT/stall-attribution/mufu_class/ and compare/mufu1)
addenda.text: Gates: CMAKE, BUILD, CTEST, PYTEST (525 passed), tree build, tree validate --strict, generated schema all 0 (build-63a77fcd.GATES.txt). K1 PASS on both devices: 376 cells each (the thirteen probe sources of manifest-place5 plus queue_basic = manifest-queue1.<device>.tsv; 4 cells per device have no ledger and are skipped: the mem_basic ldgfar cells), 16 / 14 cells with moved cycles, no (pc, class) entry differs beyond the move of unit:xu_smsp on MUFU pcs from math_pipe_throttle to mio_throttle. K2 PASS on both devices as frozen: the 15 / 13 MUFU cells of queue_basic and plan_pilot-r2 with at least 0.5 moved cycles per execution all have a lower (pc, class) error (H100 q.mufu.e2 1.358 -> 0.154, .e2.w8 1.569 -> 0.166, .e2.w16 1.687 -> 0.696, .e4 0.801 -> 0.162, .e4.w16 1.508 -> 0.773, seq.sts10_mufu6 0.586 -> 0.166, seq.mufu10_sts6 0.932 -> 0.170, seq.mufu4_f2fp4 0.343 -> 0.128, m.mufu.n4 / n8 / n16 0.314 / 0.615 / 1.091 -> 0.134 / 0.134 / 0.174, m.mufu.n8.w16 1.102 -> 0.589, m.mufu.n16.w32 1.818 -> 1.107, the two m.mix cells 0.301 / 0.286 -> 0.131 / 0.119; B300 q.mufu.e2 0.764 -> 0.161, .e2.w8 1.115 -> 0.345, .e2.w16 1.421 -> 0.848, seq.sts10_mufu6 0.384 -> 0.225, seq.mufu10_sts6 0.535 -> 0.171, seq.mufu4_f2fp4 0.210 -> 0.162, m.mufu.n4 / n8 / n16 0.314 / 0.623 / 1.043 -> 0.226 / 0.228 / 0.172, m.mufu.n8.w16 0.980 -> 0.346, m.mufu.n16.w32 1.780 -> 1.073, the two m.mix cells 0.271 -> 0.201); B300 q.mufu.e4 / .e4.w16 have no such wait and are unchanged; every other cell (359 / 362) is unchanged. What remains at 16 and 32 warps (0.59-1.11 against a floor of 0.03-0.10) is, by the queue_basic readings, where the wait sits among the MUFU and how much of it is not_selected, not its class (stage 3). Said as it happened: the judge's first version demanded 'lower' of every source and reported one cell outside K2's sources, placement_basic-r2 mb-sb-b.mufu.w8 (0.1926 -> 0.1926 / 0.1920 -> 0.1920 with 11.1 / 10.4 moved cycles): there the hardware has no throttle on the two MUFU.RCP at all (wait 1.2 and the CTA barrier), so the replay's unit wait is a timing difference and its class does not change the error; the judge was then made to follow K2's wording (lower for the two named sources, not higher elsewhere) -- the criterion's text was not changed. K3 PASS: in kind_gaps.tsv of compare/mufu1 against compare/place5 no row of another kind changes its replay or hardware value (826 / 954 rows); MUFU's replay math_pipe_throttle 1.443 / 0.654 points -> 0 and mio_throttle 0 -> 1.443 / 0.654 against the hardware's 0.870 / 0.189. Cycles: no replay was run; the per-case engine cycles, residency and per-pc error of the 500 + 500 cases are identical in the two comparisons. Full GPU before -> after (mean of 500 cases, H100 / B300): attribution 0.3522 -> 0.3306 / 0.3310 -> 0.3232; class 0.3341 -> 0.3122 / 0.2986 -> 0.2904; (site, class) 0.4576 -> 0.4397 / 0.4387 -> 0.4348; (kind, class) 0.5148 -> 0.4977 / 0.5059 -> 0.5022; (block, class) 0.5107 -> 0.4911 / 0.5926 -> 0.5888; (pc, class) 0.7130 -> 0.6996 / 0.7462 -> 0.7438; site, kind, block and pc residency errors unchanged (0.2527 / 0.2507 site, 0.5809 / 0.6271 pc). Class gaps in the loops (replay - hardware, points): mio_throttle -2.40 -> -1.08 / -0.81 -> -0.25, math_pipe_throttle +2.66 -> +1.34 / +1.86 -> +1.29. The expectation held in direction and in the overshoot on MUFU pcs (replay 1.44 / 0.65 against 0.87 / 0.19 there).
